name: Expected Attention
tagline: Score each cached key by closed-form expected dot-product against a Gaussian model of future query states (mean + covariance) under the post-RoPE distribution.
diff_from_baseline: Devoto, Jeblick, Jegou (NVIDIA) 2025, arXiv:2510.00636. Models the distribution of upcoming queries as a Gaussian and selects KV tokens by their expected attention. Reference impl: NVIDIA/kvpress ExpectedAttentionPress.

name: Full Attention (no eviction)
tagline: Anchor baseline that retains every prefill KV token; bypasses the compression path entirely.
diff_from_baseline: Hugging Face DynamicCache without eviction. Reference upper bound — quality of full attention with no cache savings; not a valid compressed submission.

name: LagKV
tagline: Lag-relative scoring: each token in window i is normalised by the next window's key/value envelope, then softmax-ranked within the window.
diff_from_baseline: Liang et al. 2025, arXiv:2504.04704 (LagKV). Per-layer training-free KV selector based on lag-window key/value variance. Reference impl: NVIDIA/kvpress LagKVPress.

name: StreamingLLM (sinks + recent)
tagline: Keep the first few attention-sink tokens plus the most recent window, drop the middle, and re-rotate retained keys to their new positions.
diff_from_baseline: Xiao et al. 2024 (StreamingLLM, ICLR), arXiv:2309.17453. Discovers attention sinks and proposes sliding-window + sink retention. Re-rotation follows kvpress KeyRerotationPress.
